Sorry... it's okay... yahi hai internet ka three-way handshake! Ye sawaal Oracle ke interview mein poocha gaya tha. Chalo, tees second mein samjho!
Client ko server se data chahiye. Socho, bas query bheji, aur data aa gaya? Nahi! Pehle dono ke beech connection banna zaroori hai, aur wo banta hai teen steps mein.
Step one, SYN! Client server ko SYN packet bhejta hai, ek random sequence number ke saath... maan lo X.
Step two, SYN-ACK! Server apna SYN bhejta hai, number Y, aur saath mein ACK, X plus one. Matlab, tumhara message mil gaya!
Step three, ACK! Client bhejta hai Y plus one. Ab connection established, aur data flow shuru!
Interviewer ka twist: do steps kyun nahi? Kyunki dono taraf ka sequence number confirm hona zaroori hai!
Ek line mein yaad rakho: SYN, SYN-ACK, ACK. Aise hi interview concepts ke liye, pretestpassed dot codes ko follow karo!
